source.design: Preselected ten SQL shape families, six modulus/literal settings, eight-row bags per case, all selected and frozen before this checker processes any of the 60 generated statements. A10-derived families deliberately enrich actual ColumnPruning coverage, with comparator/noise families. No case selection based on CI results.
source.prng: unsigned 32-bit LCG state=(1664525*state+1013904223) modulo 2^32; next signed small integer=(state modulo 61)-30
source.methodological_limit: Targeted, design-inspired and repeated-family stress test, not independent authorship and not representative random production SQL.
